title: Chromatic Danseuse - Location, Weakness & Rewards

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Chromatic Danseuse keeps the base enemy's stance mechanic: it absorbs whichever element it is currently in and is weak to the opposite. Read the stance before you commit a turn, exactly as with Stalact.

sections.title: Where to Find the Chromatic Danseuse
sections.content:
Location: Old Lumiere.

Availability: Act 2.

Chromatic enemies are optional, supercharged versions of an enemy you already fought. They are not required for the story, but they drop the better tier of materials and the weapons tied to their base enemy.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Higher-tier Chroma materials than the base Danseuse
  • Weapons and Pictos gated behind defeating the Chromatic Danseuse

Exact drop quantities for this encounter are not documented in the sources we could verify, so they are not listed rather than estimated.

sections.title: How to Beat the Chromatic Danseuse
sections.content:
Same answer as the base enemy

The Chromatic Danseuse keeps the weaknesses and resistances of the ordinary Danseuse. If you have already fought the base version, your party does not need to change - what changes is the margin for error.

What actually kills you

Chromatic variants hit harder and hold more health than the enemy they are based on. The failure mode is almost always running out of resources mid-fight rather than a mechanic you did not understand, so bring healing headroom rather than a greedier damage build.
